description: Extract clean article text from one or more URLs via Tavily: strips boilerplate/navigation and returns up to 20,000 chars of readable content per page. Accepts a single URL string or an array. Ideal for feeding source pages into an LLM.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Tavily API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

urls.description: A single URL string, or an array of URL strings, to extract clean text from.

name: extract
